subject.title: Feature: Session labels / nicknames for easier identification

question: Should user-editable session naming stay on the existing `label` field, migrate to canonical `title`, or support both through an explicit compatibility plan before adding the remaining CLI and Control UI command surfaces?
rationale: Current main and related PRs already implement overlapping pieces, but choosing the permanent field and command grammar is a product/API contract decision that automation should not settle by adding another partial surface.

options.title: Approve a canonical title/label contract first
options.body: Use PR #95182 or an equivalent maintainer-approved contract decision as the basis, then wire CLI listing, CLI rename, chat, and Control UI around that single naming model.

options.title: Keep `label` as the canonical user field
options.body: Close or narrow title-migration work and add only missing `label`-based CLI/Control UI surfaces with compatibility tests.

options.title: Split this issue into narrower follow-ups
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only for CLI naming while #93422/#93587 own Control UI command grammar and #95182 owns the protocol/data contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a canonical title/label contract first
recommendation.body: Use PR #95182 or an equivalent maintainer-approved contract decision as the basis, then wire CLI listing, CLI rename, chat, and Control UI around that single naming model.

likelyOwner.reason: The active title/label contract PR is the central unresolved API/product direction that affects every remaining surface.
